description: nhflow_2d_si_river_kepsilon with patches on walls (C 11 21, C 14 21) instead of B 60 / F 62: discharge inlet (B 440 1 at x-, B 411 1 1.0) and water level outlet (B 440 2 at x+, B 413 2 1.5). The patch faces as discharge and level faces of the semi-implicit step (nhflow_momentum_SI::bc_setup, patch_ghosts; patchBC_2D on the slice faces). Run to 20000 s the steady water level agrees with the B 60 / F 62 run to 0.1 mm except next to the inlet (1.8 mm: the uniform inlet profile instead of the log profile of B 61 2).
covers: patchBC_2D on the NHFLOW slice faces (driver), patchBC_discharge_nhflow
nhflow_momentum_SI::bc_setup patch inlet (bc_flux) and level outlet (bc_level)
